node: Data-center power distribution, low-voltage electrical equipment, cooling, and rack-level infrastructure components
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around AI data-center electrical and thermal chokepoints. The reference lane is Vertiv, which validates the node through broad power, cooling, switchgear, rack, and liquid-cooling exposure. The underfollowed lane prioritizes smaller or less technology-indexed suppliers: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and packaged power systems, Modine for data-center cooling systems, and Bel Fuse for rack/server power-conversion and connectivity components. Key bottleneck logic: AI racks raise power density, liquid-cooling adoption, electrical reliability requirements, and lead-time pressure across subsystems that are often classified as industrial, HVAC, or components rather than AI technology.
